method.imu_yaw: trapezoidal integration after stationary robust gyro-z bias removal
method.lidar: historical clockwise scan reflected in-memory; point-to-plane SE(2) ICP with zero yaw seed; overlap-weighted composition
method.correlation_warning: Adjacent scans within one segment are temporally correlated. LiDAR registration is independent of IMU yaw.

architecture.wheel_odometry: open-loop integration of commanded motor RPM
architecture.imu: raw accel/gyro only; orientation covariance[0] = -1; not fused
architecture.lidar: Nav2 obstacle/AMCL input or offline scan matching; not fused into /odom

summary.belt_slip_conclusion: IMU and LiDAR can corroborate low or reduced physical motion under command, but existing bags cannot isolate belt slip from track-ground skid, MKS motor stall/protection, or historical RS485 command-queue loss because no motor encoder feedback is recorded.
